fixes.was: After a defense verdict, Yaros sought enforcement of a $750,000 settlement she said she had accepted during trial.
fixes.now: Yaros sought enforcement of a $750,000 settlement she said she had accepted during trial, first by oral motion before the jury deliberated and again after the defense verdict.

fixes.was: The court declined to decide road-end and lake-access arguments.
fixes.now: The court declined to decide road-end access arguments as unnecessary and treated a claimed public policy favoring lake access as abandoned.

fixes.was: In Maryland, when a transaction sells consumer goods that keep their character as goods after performance and loss arises from a defect in them, implied warranties apply to those goods even though services predominate in the transaction.
fixes.now: In Maryland, when a commercial transaction sells consumer goods that retain that character after performance and monetary loss or personal injury arises from a defect in them, implied warranties apply to those goods even though consumer services predominate.
